name: Hot ginger rice dumplings
summary: Bánh trôi tàu nóng is a soft dumpling of black sesame and mung bean in hot ginger broth, and the ginger stays fragrant after you swallow. The broth is also made with coconut milk.
origin: Hạ Long. It is the sweet beside the salty plates.
taste: The skin is soft and the ginger is fragrant and sweet.
howToEat: Black sesame and mung bean, in a hot ginger broth. The skin is soft and the ginger stays after you swallow.
The broth is also ginger and coconut milk.
where: Snack stalls around trường Chuyên Hạ Long and inside chợ Cột 3, phường Hồng Hải. That ward name is from 16 Mar 2021.
priceBand: About 10,000–30,000 đồng a bowl (23 Jul 2021). Current price: Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Banh troi tau — hot ginger dumplings in Ha Long
seoDescription: Bánh trôi tàu in Hạ Long is a black-sesame and mung-bean dumpling in hot ginger broth. The broth is also made with coconut milk.
